issue.description:
ADR-004 requires a `cargo +1.85 check --all-targets` lane in the bead-rs-ci WorkflowTemplate, pinned to the same version the manifest declares, with drift between the lane's toolchain pin and Cargo.toml's `rust-version` being a CI failure rather than a doc nit. No open bead tracks this deliverable (the dependency-refresh portion of the ADR is recorded as done 2026-08-22, the lane is not). Confirm whether the lane exists in declarative-config (k8s/iad-ci/argo-workflows/); if absent, add it; add the explicit drift check; run the workflow and record the evidence on the bead.
